FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.question1: What calculation method does it use?
FAQ.answer1: The in-arrears French method, with a 360-day basis and a 30-day commercial month, as financial practice requires.
FAQ.question2: Can I use a nominal or effective rate?
FAQ.answer2: Both. You register the rate agreed per customer and VaultChecker converts and applies it.
FAQ.answer3: Yes, by overdue days, and it applies the late-fee → interest → principal order.
FAQ.question4: Does it work for any business?
FAQ.answer4: Yes: grocers, greengrocers, butchers, pharmacies and more. It's multi-store.
